output.one_liner: Brex is a unified spend platform with corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay, with an API for custom workflows.

auth.notes: User tokens (bearer tokens) generated by account/card admin from Brex dashboard for direct API calls. OAuth2 for partner authentication; partner access requires contacting developer support for client ID/secret.

evidence.snippet: To pass your user token to Brex APIs, add it as a header to your API calls in the following format
Brex currently supports 2 different authorization grant types: Authorization Code Grant, Client Credentials Grant
Pass it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_BREX_ACCESS_TOKEN

access.notes: Documentation only covers credential generation for existing Brex customers with admin/card admin access. No information on how new developers obtain initial credentials, sandbox access, or free tier availability.

evidence.snippet: Sign in to dashboard.brex.com as an account admin or card admin. Go to Developer Settings.
This guide assumes you are a Brex customer with admin access to your dashboard.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 1,000 requests per 60 seconds per Client ID and account; 1,000 transfers per 24 hours; 100 international wires per 24 hours; 5,000 cards created per 24 hours

evidence.snippet: Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification and use standard HTTP response codes
Accounting API, Budgets API, Expenses API, Fields API, Onboarding API, Payments API, Team API, Transactions API, Travel API, Webhooks API
Per Client ID and Brex account, we allow: Up to 1,000 requests in 60 seconds
The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account: manage expenses, look up users, check cards
The server is hosted at https://api.brex.com/mcp and supports any MCP-compatible client.

buildability.rationale: Composio toolkit with 84 tools already built; REST API well-documented, OpenAPI-specified, broad coverage across 10 API domains, webhooks supported.

overview_evidence.snippet: Brex is the first fully unified spend platform — with global corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay.

unknown_reasons.access: Pages document credential flows only for existing Brex customers with admin access. No information on sandbox environments, trial periods, or how non-customers obtain API access.
